We are looking for a finance and operations professional to help us scale our operations and elevate how we run source-to-pay at Netflix. The Finance Procurement Operations (FPO) team supports Netflix’s Source-to-Pay processes - how we source, procure, and pay our partners around the world. Within FPO, the Strategic Operations team is a strategic thought partner to leaders; we drive alignment across FPO, project-manage big cross-functional bets, drive impact and results, and help prioritize the FinTech and engineering work that powers our operations.

We’re looking for a Program Analyst to help us scale how we work. 

The ideal candidate for this role is someone with a solid understanding of the S2P workflow, experience in project management, a process-innovation mindset, and a passion for developing strong cross-functional relationships. This position will be based in our Los Angeles office and report to the Strategic Operations Manager. 

Responsibilities:

Work closely with Program Leads and FPO leadership to support programs and strategies that improve our global operations.

Help define how we measure success for key programs: baselines, targets, and impact

Support FPO strategies and programs by providing project management support

Manage project plans, timelines, status updates, and escalations/risk to ensure everyone is aligned and the project is on track

Drive follow-through on decisions and action items with stakeholders across time zones.

Use data and process insight to identify what’s working, what’s not, and where we should focus.

FinTech / Systems Prioritization Support: 

Help translate operational needs into clear requirements and input to engineering and product teams (e.g., Workday Financials, workflow tools, support tools).

Review FPO-driven FinTech projects and perform prioritization and impact analysis to determine what Engineering works on

Support UAT and rollout for new features or tools, and help track adoption and impact.

Support change management: communications, training materials, FAQs, and light enablement for process or tool changes.

Qualities We’re Looking For

3-6 years of experience in Operational Finance, Finance/Procurement Operations, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, or Program/Project Management 

Familiarity with S2P workflows (requisitions, POs, invoices, payments, vendor setup/management) is a plus.

You’re analytically minded - comfortable working with data (Excel/Sheets, basic BI tools), spotting patterns, and turning numbers into insight.

You’re a structured problem-solver who can bring order to ambiguity and break big problems into manageable pieces.

You’re organized and able to juggle multiple workstreams without dropping details.

You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, and you’re comfortable drafting concise decks and memos for different audiences.

You enjoy understanding how things actually work end-to-end, and you’re motivated to make them better.

You build strong relationships and are effective in a cross-matrixed, global environment.

Experience with tools like Workday Financials, SmartSheets, Tableau, Freshdesk, or AI solutions is a plus, but not a requirement. You learn new tools quickly.

In April 2022, we introduced a new, more affordable, ad-supported tier for our customers, marking a significant milestone for Netflix. Our focus is now on expanding choices for consumers and providing advertisers with a premium TV brand experience that surpasses traditional linear formats. The challenge ahead involves scaling our ad tech to maximize its impact on our business.

Our Team

The Ads Platform Engineering teams build advertising systems and integrations that power the delivery of ads using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads - unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state of the art content delivery system, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving, members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

The Creatives Team is building the robust, scalable backbone that powers all creative workflows across the Netflix Ads platform. The ability to scale how quickly advertisers are able to bring their creatives, get them processed, reviewed and deployed to reach the right member on our platform is crucial for our success. This team will build out our creative infrastructure that works across our broadening supply sources (SVOD, Live and FTAB), enables scalability and sophistication (leveraging the best in class ML / genAI algorithms) and manages effective distribution for ad decisioning and serving even as we bring in more cardinality and flexibility of units that span a large variety of devices. 

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a rapidly evolving space, enabling autonomy in the CTV marketplace. If you're passionate about high-impact work, cutting-edge ad tech, and contributing to a global product, we invite you to help us define the next era of advertising at Netflix.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

Deep Expertise in Distributed Systems: Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable distributed systems. This includes a strong understanding of concurrency, parallel processing, and microservices architecture.

Fluency in at least one core Programming Languages - Java, Python or Go with a history of writing production-quality, well-tested code.

Operational Excellence and Observability: Experience with setting up and maintaining comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting systems (e.g., using tools like Spinnaker, Prometheus, Grafana, or proprietary solutions) to ensure system reliability and quick diagnosis of issues.

Proven Problem-Solving Capability: The ability to tackle complex, ambiguous technical problems and develop pragmatic, long-term solutions.

Strong Collaboration and Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. A history of successfully collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g., Product Management, Design, and other Engineering teams) is necessary.

Ownership and Drive: A proactive mindset and a strong sense of ownership over the entire software development lifecycle, from initial design through deployment, operations, and eventual deprecation.

Nice to Haves:

Experience in the Ads Domain: prior experience building or operating infrastructure specifically for digital advertising, including creative management, ad serving, or campaign optimization platforms, is a significant advantage.

Experience with creative lifecycle management and pipeline development.

Experience with machine learning applications in advertising, particularly in ad review systems.

Experience building large-scale infrastructure for real-time, low-latency online advertising environments.

Knowledge of the CTV space and its unique constraints.

The Opportunity 

The Casting Business Affairs Team at Netflix is seeking an experienced professional for an associate role to support the US/Canada/UK Scripted Series group. Members of this team are the subject matter experts on engaging guest performers, stunt performers, singers and dancers to work on Netflix's award winning scripted series. 

The Role

In Casting Business Affairs you will play a primary role in structuring, negotiating, and drafting guest performer deals and agreements, collaborating with internal and external partners to oversee the entire process necessary for guest performers on a production. This includes coordinating with casting, business and legal affairs, production, accounting, post-production, credits, residuals, and other internal and external teams throughout all stages of a series from pre-production to production and post-production. Your adaptability and capacity to work proactively under tight timeframes will be crucial as you navigate this dynamic environment that is ever changing. Candidates should embrace and advocate for cultural diversity while upholding the highest standards of professionalism and integrity. 

Responsibilities

Work closely with external casting to advise on deal structure and strategy for guest performers.

Serve as the primary point of contact between Netflix and talent agents and attorneys regarding guest performer agreements.

Review and approve project-specific guest performer deals, ensuring accuracy, signatures, and payment details.

Advise and educate producers, casting, production, finance, post-production, and business affairs teams (in-house and external partners) on the requirements under SAG-AFTRA (and/or other performer union) contracts.

Work closely with in-house Creative Casting to provide optimal support to external partners.

Provide guidance to post-production regarding cast contract requirements when modifying scenes, including moving, splitting, and deleting scenes, as well as ADR/Loop Group payments.

Coordinate with Screen Credits, Residuals, and Legal Delivery teams to maintain an efficient workflow.

Willingness to work on new subjects outside area of expertise, take on special projects, and support all areas of the Casting Business Affairs Team as the need arises

Requirements

High proficiency in contract review, structuring, and drafting, as well as negotiating complex talent/performer agreements.

Experience with SAG-AFTRA, ACTRA and/or UBCP Collective Bargaining Agreements

Familiarity with the production process and the key players

Exhibit sound judgment and adept critical thinking skills in various situations, enabling effective problem-solving and decision-making.

Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills 

Preferred

BA/BS degree, JD applicants welcome 

Comprehensive knowledge of SAG rules and deal structures for guest performers

Experience with Google Suite, i.e., Google Docs, Google Sheets

Key to the effort to build a global internet TV network is the ability to grow and evolve our revenue-generating initiatives worldwide. We continue to introduce new commerce models, pricing strategies, and other opportunities to grow the business, and now you have the chance to join the growing team of finance experts who support them. Our Revenue team is seeking a Collections Analyst to support our Credit & Collections function. This newly created position will look to resolve complex issues and consequently improve the speed of collections across our business lines, such as Advertising, Partnerships, and Consumer Products. This role will be based in New York but will work cross-functionally across many time zones with our US and other international offices.

 

The perfect candidate will be hands-on and thrive when engaging directly with customers and business partners. They will be an excellent communicator who is comfortable speaking directly with senior management both with our customers and also within our internal teams. They will have the ability to negotiate and adapt to a multitude of different and ever-changing scenarios, always finding a pathway to a positive resolution.

 

They will be very detail-oriented, able to analyze and action a large volume of requests & transactions with high accuracy, and be capable of multitasking and taking the initiative to drive process change and improvements.

 

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 

Ensure that Netflix is paid on time by reviewing aging reports and worklists regularly to identify and follow up on overdue balances in a timely manner.

Reach out to customers with overdue balances via phone, email, or written communication to ensure timely payment. Maintain a professional, courteous, and solution-focused approach when addressing late payments.

Foster strong customer relationships to ensure future payments are received on time and disputes are minimized.

Provide exceptional levels of customer service and professionalism in customer interactions whilst also ensuring company interests are protected.

Be a trusted business partner and provide exceptional service levels when interacting with internal Netflix teams and colleagues.

Ensure detailed notes are kept on all interactions with the customer, including any requests for payment, disputes, agreements, and commitments.

Provide regular account reviews/account updates to your manager.

Escalate ‘problem accounts’ in good time to your manager and business partners to assist in issue resolution.

Prepare support packages for accounts being forwarded for write-offs, 3rd-party collection, legal action, bankruptcy filings, etc., as needed.

Address and resolve in real time, where possible, any disputes related to outstanding balances. Work with the customer and internal teams (Dispute Management, Sales, Legal, etc.) to ensure dispute resolution.

Manage and maintain changes to customer contact information, addresses, and other critical billing and reporting details.

Ensure remittance details for incoming payments are received and that the Cash Applications team has the information needed to successfully post cash.

Manage portal billing as required by the customers.

Support monthly accounting close activities as needed.

Assist in the development of strategies to reduce delinquency rates, increase the speed of payment, and minimize bad debt by analyzing past-due accounts, identifying trends, process gaps, and making recommendations for process improvements.

 QUALITIES WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

Deep knowledge and understanding of Accounts Receivable and Collections processes.

Thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume transaction environment.

Comfortable engaging in direct conversations with customers and internal business partners, including senior management.

Ability to maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail in preparing and entering financial information.

Customer Service-oriented person who focuses on quality communication with high levels of professionalism.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in other languages (Spanish / Portuguese) is a plus.

Highly motivated with the ability to work independently.

Forward-looking thinker who does not simply accept the status quo but can articulate the need for and contribute to process Improvement and positive change.

Works with a sense of urgency and sensitivity to last-minute, highly critical business requests.

Uses good judgment and knows when to make a decision and when to escalate.

Exemplifies the Netflix Culture.

 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree (Finance-related a plus)

At least 4 years of experience in a collections environment.

Experience in communicating directly with customers

Proven ability to handle high volumes of collection activities in a fast-paced environment

Experience at a Global Company

Knowledge of cloud-related ERP systems is a plus (Workday, HighRadius, Salesforce)

Position Summary

We are seeking CG Experimental Artists to join our pioneering team creating animated shorts and specials using experimental GenAI-native production pipelines. Working alongside Directors, Producers, and technology teams, this role will help support show-specific workflow and technical needs as we aim to develop feature-quality content in a creator-led environment. Artists on this team will help shape storytelling and visual aesthetics with creative leadership, actively participating in the development of new workflows and technologies as we expand from shorts to longer-form content.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with a team of CG and Generative AI experts to develop unique content for animated shorts and specials, leveraging a GenAI-native pipeline that combines generative AI tools with traditional animation techniques.

Work closely with creative leadership to shape storytelling and visual aesthetics that meet feature-quality standards and align with the creative vision of the Director and project leads.

Contribute to the creation of short stories in a fast-paced, sprint-based production environment.

Actively participate in creative discussions and brainstorming sessions.

Use GenAI tools such as ComfyUI to generate concept frames, style frames, character explorations, and environment designs based on scripts, outlines, or verbal direction.

Experiment with and evaluate the latest generative tooling and be open to testing new technology throughout the development process.

Create shot-ready assets (e.g., characters, props, environments) using a combination of generative tools and traditional DCCs (Photoshop, Maya, Houdini, Harmony, Blender, etc.).

Build and fine-tune generative image and video models.

Test and compare multiple generative tools and workflows (e.g., different models, LoRAs, motion tools), document results, and recommend best practices to the team.

Help develop and document new GenAI/traditional hybrid workflows, collaborating with production and technology teams to improve efficiency and creative output.

Qualifications

Experience with ComfyUI and traditional CG 2D and/or 3D DCCs such as Photoshop, Maya, Houdini, Harmony, and/or Blender.

Experience with creating and animating assets (terrains, layout, characters, control-rigs, lighting) within Unreal Engine.

Ability to help develop character and visual designs that align with the desired style and sensibility, focusing on character personality, mood, and tone.

Strong conceptual understanding of diffusion-based rendering and animation techniques. Experience training image LoRAs, video LoRAs, and similar are a plus.

Strong collaborative skills and ability to work in a team environment with Directors, Producers, and technology leads, often in rapidly evolving, experimental pipelines.

Passion for storytelling and animation with a portfolio showcasing the ability to create compelling narratives using AI tools. Demonstrates excellence and inspiration in storytelling, visual comedy, and innovative thinking, with a strong understanding of how to leverage generative AI tools to enhance creative storytelling.

Ability to adapt to new technologies and tools and quickly pivot in this fast-moving field where workflows and creative approaches are being developed in real time.

High level of independence and initiative, as production support structures and workflows will be evolving alongside the creative process.

The Team

The Studio Media Algorithms team is at the forefront of algorithmic innovation to enhance and support the creation of Netflix’s entertainment content, including games. In this role, you will be embedded within this team while collaborating very closely with a specialized Games Studio R&D team. This incubation-style team is chartered to lead our investments in building new kinds of games leveraging emerging technologies to support our creators and reach player audiences in new ways.

The Role

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on MLOps, deployment, and performance optimization to help bridge the gap between research and production in the gaming space. You will work cross-functionally with games technical directors, designers, and scientists to ensure that novel AI-driven game concepts can be deployed efficiently across a variety of hardware environments.

In this role, you will:

Build and maintain MLOps pipelines: Develop robust CI/CD for ML, model registries, and automated deployment workflows to support rapid iteration.

Optimize for performance: Profile and benchmark models across cloud GPUs and edge devices (e.g., Nsight, PyTorch Profiler) to identify bottlenecks and implement hardware acceleration.

Scale deployment: Design and implement model deployment strategies for both Cloud and Edge environments, ensuring efficient, low-latency execution in game runtimes.

Enhance model efficiency: Apply precision tuning and quantization techniques to meet latency, cost, and memory constraints without significant quality loss. 

Collaborate on integration: Work with game engineers to integrate ML models into game engine pipelines and APIs.

About You

The Ad Supply team manages the policies and technical integrations for third-party ad supply. While Netflix has traditionally licensed content, we're exploring this alternative funding model. They establish clear rules for inventory sharing, campaign setup, and system configurations to ensure consistency and fairness.

The Ads Measurement team builds systems that enable advertisers on Netflix to quantify campaign outcomes. Leveraging a blend of Netflix innovations and both first-party and third-party solutions, we deliver ads that respect the viewing experience while driving impactful results for advertisers. The Ads Identity and Audience team is dedicated to delivering a relevant and engaging advertising experience while prioritizing consumer privacy. Together, we provide the technical backbone that drives consistency, reliability, and velocity across Ads.

The Ads Data Clean Room team is redefining how clean rooms are used in digital advertising. We’re building data collaboration tools as internal services, allowing multiple teams to share data with external partners in a convenient and privacy-safe way. As the ads data landscape evolves, our team will continue to lead by creating new ways to enable collaboration while protecting privacy.

The Ads Finance platform centralizes and validates all the raw data—from campaign performance to pricing structures—needed to calculate and bill our diverse advertising revenue streams. This ensures financial integrity and consistency, providing a reliable foundation for all core Ad business operations, including budgeting, predicting future revenue, and managing credit and pricing strategies.

The Ads Eventing team builds and operates the foundational systems that collect, validate, enrich, and deliver ads-related events at a massive scale. These high-throughput data pipelines ingest raw signals from client devices (TV, mobile), server-side ad insertions, and external third-party integrations. The core mission is to transform these raw signals into clean, reliable, and privacy-safe data streams, ensuring data quality and fidelity across the board. This critical infrastructure directly powers all core downstream functions, including real-time ad serving decisions, robust measurement and attribution systems, and financial reconciliation and billing workflows.

Their focus is on building the systems that consume validated and enriched ads delivery data to power the comprehensive reporting surfaces used by internal teams and advertisers to analyze campaign performance and business outcomes. They ensure the data presented is accurate, timely, and easy to consume, enabling key functions like measurement and attribution analysis, financial reconciliation, and strategic decision-making based on business results.

Our intuitive UI and intelligent automation agents surface critical, actionable insights, empowering our sales teams to cut through the noise, focus on high-value client engagements, and accelerate the success of Netflix Ads.
